story.title: Gold Rate Today: Check 24K, 22K Gold Prices in Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Bengaluru on September 11
story.summary: Chennai reported the highest gold and silver prices today, while Delhi reported the lowest prices among the major Indian cities.

story.title: Hong Kong court sentences 3 Tiananmen vigil organisers to prison in national security case
story.summary: Lee received a 7-year prison term and Chow was sentenced to 7 years and 3 months. Both pleaded not guilty. Ho was given a lower sentence of 5 years and 2 months, partly because he pleaded guilty

story.title: American Shelton to face Zverev in US Open final
story.summary: Ben Shelton powers past Frances Tiafoe in an all-American US Open semi-final to earn a spot in Sunday's final against number one seed Alexander Zverev.

story.title: India sends first consignment of Bailey bridge components to flood-hit Nepal
story.summary: India has sent more than 130 tonnes of relief material and deployed 54 expert personnel to support Nepal's rescue, relief and forensic operations, according to the MEA.

story.title: Calibrated capitulation: Congress slams PM Modi after his meeting with Xi
story.summary: Mr. Ramesh's remarks came a day after PM Modi conveyed to Chinese President Xi that peace and tranquillity along the frontier remains an "essential" basis for development of India-China relations
